video_title: Orlando Magic's Jonathan Isaac on Faith Under the Spotlight, the NBA Season and UNITUS — Ep. 1320

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on the Magic's upcoming season and training camp
quotes.excerpt: I just do whatever coach tells me to do and if I'm playing, I'm playing, if I'm not, I'm not.

text_blocks.speaker: Cameron Stang
text_blocks.text: NBA season is about to start. You guys are getting into training camp, media day, next week, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
text_blocks.text: Yep. Training camp is Tuesday, media day Monday. Another year, man. You're 10.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on navigating frustration and staying ready
quotes.excerpt: I just do whatever coach tells me to do and if I'm playing, I'm playing, if I'm not, I'm not.

text_blocks.speaker: Cameron Stang
text_blocks.text: How did that affect you as a human? Not just as a player. How do you deal with that? You can't control your own destiny in some respects. If you don't get put in, how do you stay ready and stay mentally not let that bog you down?

text_blocks.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
text_blocks.text: It's twofold. One, it's a job. We have a responsibility to show up and be in the right head space, be in the right mindset and play. At the same time, it's exactly what you're saying. You have this desire and this dream to play basketball and you want to be a part of it and your destiny in a sense is in somebody else's hands. That's where the frustration really comes in. I just do whatever coach tells me to do and if I'm playing, I'm playing, if I'm not, I'm not.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on the Magic's team chemistry and coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: I feel like everything is clicking and where it needs to be and I feel like we're going to surprise a lot of people.

text_blocks.speaker: Cameron Stang
text_blocks.text: How do you feel going into this season?

text_blocks.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
text_blocks.text: I'm excited. Outside of me personally, just from the team standpoint, I'm excited for us with Coach Mosley and the coaching staff that's been. It's been amazing, man. All the guys who've been back, we've been able to get up and down and just watching them and watching everybody kind of soak up what Coach Mosley and the coaching staff is preparing for us. Just excited. I feel like everything is clicking and where it needs to be and I feel like we're going to surprise a lot of people.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on his faith journey and finding identity
quotes.excerpt: I felt like I had this desire to do everything that the NBA has to offer, which I did, and finding that, oh man, I still feel as unfulfilled as I felt chasing that thing.

text_blocks.speaker: Cameron Stang
text_blocks.text: You mentioned your faith. For those listening or watching that don't know, tell us a little bit about your faith story and how you came to Lord and all that.

text_blocks.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
text_blocks.text: I grew up in church. I kind of have the same story as a lot of people where you're introduced to faith at a young age, but for it's really just a traditional thing. Your family takes you, you learn the songs, you go to the youth group, but it's not something that you actually own or that you really understand. It wasn't until basketball became what I would say is my god, from middle school, high school, college, I'm focused on I want to be like these guys, I'm going to play in the NBA, I want to do all these things. It wasn't until I was able to experience it all at the highest level in the NBA and feeling like I had this desire to do everything that the NBA has to offer, which I did, and finding that, oh man, I still feel as unfulfilled as I felt chasing that thing. That for me made me take a step back and go, you know what, maybe this faith stuff that I learned as a kid, maybe that really is the answer.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on prioritizing personal growth and faith over public expectations
quotes.excerpt: I want to focus on myself and my relationship with Christ and growing in that way
quotes.quote: I don't speak as much, I don't do as much as I've done in the past, just from a standpoint of wanting to focus on myself and my relationship with Christ and growing in that way, rather than being whatever everybody else needs you to be.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Strang
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Strang on the pressure Christian athletes face to conform to agendas
quotes.excerpt: I felt like you were being pulled into a world that you didn't ask for

text_blocks.speaker: Cameron Strang
text_blocks.text: I observed you very sincerely speaking about your faith and then Christian leaders who maybe had an agenda, whether it be a political agenda or whatever, were like, 'Hey, he's one of us. Let's platform him.' I felt like you were being pulled into a world that you didn't ask for in some respects.

text_blocks.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
text_blocks.text: Man, I wish we did more than what it is. I really don't have an answer as to how to stop that. It is one of those things that is just the nature of us as people. It's difficult. If I was speaking to Christian athletes or up-and-coming players that are going to be on the big stages, it really is about the people that are around you and having people that you really trust.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on the importance of surrounding yourself with trusted leaders
quotes.excerpt: It's about the people that are around you and having people that you really trust
quotes.quote: It really is about the people that are around you and having people that you really trust, especially when it comes to your leaders in a church setting. Having somebody where it's not just you having this platform and navigating it by yourself. Because then, in my opinion, it's easier to fall for that pressure of feeling like you need to present a certain way.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on the origin and mission of his brand, UNITUS
quotes.excerpt: I ended up not resigning with Nike and I was talking to my pastor and he said
quotes.quote: I got injured and I was signed to Nike at the time of my injury. I ended up not resigning with Nike and I was talking to my pastor and he said, 'Why don't you make your own shoe?' I was kind of like, 'That's not how it works. Players don't just make their own shoes.' But it's kind of going off of his leadership and saying, 'Look into it.' And so I did.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on integrating faith into his brand's design and purpose
quotes.excerpt: It has to have scripture on it. There has to be an element of faith
quotes.quote: It started off just kind of me focused. How do I create a shoe that represents Jonathan Isaac? We landed on it has to have scripture on it. There has to be an element of faith a part of the shoe that I'm going to wear in the NBA. As we did that, we came out with the Judah 1 that really took off and kind of blossomed into, 'Man, how can we cultivate this thing as a way to help athletes and everyday people stay connected to Christ?'

quotes.speaker: Cameron Strang
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Strang and Jonathan Isaac on the leadership of the UNITUS CEO
quotes.excerpt: A former Nike exec who ran Kobe brand is running UNITUS now

text_blocks.speaker: Cameron Strang
text_blocks.text: One of our common friends, a former Nike exec who ran Kobe brand is running UNITUS now.

text_blocks.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
text_blocks.text: John is our CEO, great guy, loves the Lord. He makes it very easy for me. He has the heart, in my opinion, his heart is in the right place about why it is that we're doing this, and his desire is simply to help people stay connected to Christ.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on the upcoming release of the Emmanuel 1 shoe
quotes.excerpt: The shoe we're going to be dropping here pretty soon, October 9th is the Emmanuel 1
quotes.quote: The shoe we're going to be dropping here pretty soon, October 9th is the Emmanuel 1, and it has Matthew 1:23 on it, and it talks about how Jesus is Emmanuel, God with us. It's such an important reminder for us as Christians that Christ is with us. God is with us at all times.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Isaac on finding peace in God's redemption of his story
quotes.excerpt: He's using all of it. He's truly compassionate and loving and he's with us every single step
quotes.quote: There's parts of my story, there's parts of my life, there's parts of things in the past that I wish I did differently, mistakes that I've made, and parts that I want to throw away and kind of get rid of. And I feel like with what the Lord has been encouraging me with lately is that he's using all of it. That he is he's truly compassionate and loving and he's with us every single step of the way, and he takes all of that into account and redeems it all.
